# Indian Missile Tracker

> An interactive 3D-globe visualization and citation-backed, open-source database of India's
> missile flight tests — 362 verified tests across 47 systems, from 1985 to 2026. It is the
> first consolidated, machine-readable public record of India's missile flight-test programme.

The Indian Missile Tracker maps every known flight test of India's military missile programme onto
a 3D globe, with indicative trajectories, operational range rings, outcomes (success / partial /
failure), and per-record sources. Every figure comes from open sources and carries a confidence
rating. Not affiliated with the Government of India or DRDO.

## Coverage
- 362 verified flight tests · 47 systems · 5 launch facilities · 1985–2026.
- Systems include the Agni family (Agni-I to Agni-V, Agni-Prime), Prithvi (I–III), Dhanush,
  Shaurya, Pinaka, Prahaar; cruise missiles BrahMos / BrahMos-ER / BrahMos-A, Nirbhay, LRLACM;
  submarine-launched K-15 Sagarika, K-4, K-5; air defence PAD / AAD / PDV / AD-1; the Mission
  Shakti anti-satellite test; surface-to-air Akash, QRSAM, MRSAM, VL-SRSAM; air-to-air Astra;
  anti-tank Nag / HELINA / MPATGM; anti-ship NASM-SR; and the HSTDV hypersonic demonstrator.
- Launch sites: Integrated Test Range (Chandipur), Dr A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Island (Wheeler Island),
  Offshore Visakhapatnam, Pokhran Test Range, Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Sriharikota).

## Sourcing policy
Sources are ranked PIB / official > Indian news > foreign news; Wikipedia is never cited (further
reading only). Disputed figures (e.g. official vs analyst-assessed range) are stored as structured,
individually-sourced claims.

## Machine-readable resources
- Full dataset (JSON): https://indianmissiletracker.harshcasper.dev/data.json
- New entries (RSS): https://indianmissiletracker.harshcasper.dev/rss.xml

## Views
- Map: 3D globe of every test (trajectories + range rings), with chronological playback.
- Analytics: tests by year, category mix, by service, reliability, range ladder, heatmap.
- Database: sortable, filterable, citation-backed record table.
